description: List crafting recipes for an item. By default returns only recipes craftable with the bot's current inventory (recipesFor); set includeUnavailable to list every known recipe (recipesAll). Set useCraftingTable to consider table-only recipes using a crafting table within 4 blocks.

includeUnavailable.description: List all known recipes, not just currently craftable ones (default false)

item.description: Item name (e.g. "diamond_pickaxe") or numeric item id

minResultCount.description: Minimum result count to require (recipesFor only; default 1)

useCraftingTable.description: Allow recipes that need a crafting table, using one within 4 blocks (default false)

name: list_recipes
